sections.text:
Ability Power 200. Damages all enemies with physical light damage.
-Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.-
Increases the stats of all allies by 30% for 60 seconds.-
Reduces physical and magic damage received by all allies to 0 for 1 time.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases Ability Power of light Great Spirit Unison Attack by 20 if summoned using this Unison Skill.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 200-Ability-Power attack that deals physical light damage to all enemies by 100.
[Additional Unison Effect] During Element Battles when this Unison effect is used, the values of the Dark and Time element weakening effects on monsters are increased by 10%.
